2026-12-18.title: 18 December · Advent Weekday (O Adonai)
readings: I will raise up for David a righteous Branch
Justice shall flourish in his time, and fullness of peace for ever
Jesus is born of Mary, betrothed to Joseph, son of David
2026-12-18.alt: O Antiphon: O Adonai (O Lord and Ruler of the house of Israel).
2026-12-18.verse: Joseph, son of David, do not be afraid to take Mary as your wife, for the child conceived in her is from the Holy Spirit. She will bear a son, and you are to name him Jesus, for he will save his people from their sins.
theo: Today's O Antiphon: “O Adonai, and leader of the house of Israel, who appeared to Moses in the fire of the burning bush and gave him the law on Sinai: come and redeem us with outstretched arm.” Jeremiah promises: “I will raise up for David a righteous Branch… And this is the name by which he will be called: ‘The LORD is our righteousness.’”

Matthew tells the story from Joseph's side. Mary is found with child; Joseph, “a righteous man and unwilling to expose her to public disgrace”, plans to dismiss her quietly. In a dream the angel tells him the child is from the Holy Spirit and gives him two tasks: take Mary as your wife, and name the child Jesus, “for he will save his people from their sins”. By naming him, Joseph makes Jesus legally a son of David. All this fulfils Isaiah: “the virgin shall conceive and bear a son, and they shall name him Emmanuel, God is with us.” Joseph awakes and obeys, without a word recorded.
outline: Ask: when did God ask you to change your plans?
God raises a just King from David's line.
A just man who listened and obeyed.
He saves from sin; God is with us.
“He will save his people from their sins.”
live: Do at once one thing God has been asking of you.
Pray to St Joseph for fathers and for families in difficulty.
2026-12-18.prayer: O Adonai, Lord who spoke to Moses in the burning bush, come and redeem us with outstretched arm. Give me the faith of St Joseph to listen, to trust and to obey, and let Jesus be born in my home. Amen.
altar: At Mass Emmanuel, God with us, comes into our midst. With Joseph, we receive him with reverence and care.

quick: God raises a righteous Branch from David.
Joseph listened and obeyed without a word.
Jesus saves from sin; Emmanuel, God is with us.
2026-12-18.action: Pray to St Joseph for families in difficulty.
2026-12-18.question: Am I willing to change my plans for God?

family.explain: An angel told Joseph not to be afraid. Joseph trusted God and took care of Mary and baby Jesus.
family.intention: We pray for fathers and for everyone who is afraid.
family.ask: Ask: “How can we be like Joseph and take care of each other?”

pm.open: O Adonai, who gave the law on Sinai, come and redeem us with outstretched arm. Lord, through St Joseph's prayers, teach us to hear and obey your word. Amen.
share: Joseph was just and merciful (Matthew 1:19). How do I balance justice and mercy?
The angel said: do not be afraid (Matthew 1:20). What fear is holding me back?
How can I imitate Joseph's quiet obedience?
interc: For the Church, that, like St Joseph, she may protect Christ in the world.
For fathers, that they may be just, merciful and faithful.
For those afraid of the future, that they may trust in God.
For leaders, that they may execute justice and righteousness.
For our families, that we may welcome Jesus this Christmas.
pm.close: Lord God, you entrusted your Son to the care of St Joseph. Make us just and merciful like him, and ready to obey your word without fear. Amen.

illus: A young father in Ernakulam lost his job a month before his child's birth. He was tempted to despair. He prayed to St Joseph every night: “You also had no room at the inn.” A week after the birth he found new work. He named his son Joseph.

homily: Dear friends, today's O Antiphon prays: O Adonai, ruler of the house of Israel, who appeared to Moses in the flame of the burning bush and gave him the law on Sinai: come and redeem us with outstretched arm.

Jeremiah announces: the days are surely coming, says the Lord, when I will raise up for David a righteous Branch, and he shall reign as king and deal wisely, and shall execute justice and righteousness in the land. And this is the name by which he will be called: The Lord is our righteousness (Jeremiah 23:5–6).

In the Gospel we meet St Joseph. Mary is found to be with child from the Holy Spirit. Joseph, being a righteous man and unwilling to expose her to public disgrace, planned to dismiss her quietly. But an angel says to him in a dream: Joseph, son of David, do not be afraid to take Mary as your wife (Matthew 1:18–20).

Joseph's righteousness is not cold legalism. Even before the angel speaks, his justice is merciful: he will not shame Mary. Then, when God speaks, he obeys immediately: when Joseph awoke from sleep, he did as the angel commanded him (Matthew 1:24).

The angel tells him to name the child Jesus, for he will save his people from their sins, and calls him Emmanuel, God is with us (Matthew 1:21–23). Joseph gives Jesus his name and his place in the house of David. Without words, he serves God's plan.

Joseph is a model for fathers and for all of us: just and merciful, attentive to God's voice, quick to obey, faithful in silence. This Christmas, let us ask St Joseph to help us make room for Jesus in our homes, and not to be afraid. Amen.
kids: Children, Joseph listened to the angel and took care of Mary and baby Jesus. Ask St Joseph to help you obey God!

intro: The righteous Branch, Joseph's obedient faith, and the name of Jesus.

sub: A King who deals wisely and justly.
His name: The Lord is our righteousness.
q: The days are surely coming, says the LORD, when I will raise up for David a righteous Branch, and he shall reign as king and deal wisely, and shall execute justice and righteousness in the land. In his days Judah will be saved and Israel will live in safety. And this is the name by which he will be called: “The LORD is our righteousness.”

Joseph, son of David, do not be afraid to take Mary as your wife, for the child conceived in her is from the Holy Spirit. She will bear a son, and you are to name him Jesus, for he will save his people from their sins.
points.apply: Pray for just leaders in our country.

q: Therefore the Lord himself will give you a sign. Look, the young woman is with child and shall bear a son, and shall name him Immanuel.
“Look, the virgin shall conceive and bear a son, and they shall name him Emmanuel,” which means, “God is with us.”
points.apply: Pray “Emmanuel, be with us” at each meal today.

q: Noah did this; he did all that God commanded him.
When Joseph awoke from sleep, he did as the angel of the Lord commanded him; he took her as his wife.
points.apply: Do at once one thing God asks of you.

concl: God is with us in Jesus.
Like Joseph, let us listen and obey.
2026-12-18.resolve: Pray to St Joseph daily until Christmas.
